players.product: Turnkey HPC data-center campuses leased to hyperscalers (Barber Lake, Black Pearl, Stingray - Texas) - ex-Bitcoin-mining, now 'Cipher Digital'

quarterly_data.quarter: Cipher Digital press release: Cipher Digital Begins Development of Lateral Pipelines to (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cipher Digital has begun developing lateral pipelines at multiple sites to connect them to nearby natural gas supplies, enabling on-site bring-your-own-generation of up to 2.5 GW of electricity; it will work with power providers to develop and operate the generation, and building the pipelines is a significant step toward making new power available to the sites before the end of 2027. Cipher plans to use this capacity to develop and lease additional industrial-scale HPC data center capacity. CEO Tyler Page: 'bringing our own electricity generation allows us to unlock significant new capacity quickly'; Cipher plans to seek grid connection for this generation capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 2.5 GW of on-site generation; new power before the end of 2027
